tickets.label: Support tickets
tickets.system: Classify each support ticket as billing, meter, or account. Billing is invoices and payments; meter is the physical meter and readings; account is login, password and contact details. Return JSON only with a results array. Return exactly one object per input, preserving its id. /no_think

extraction.label: Document extraction
extraction.description: Extract invoice references and amounts from twelve fictional notes.
extraction.system: Extract the invoice reference and final amount due from each fictional note. Return amount_cents as an integer in euro cents. Ignore old balances, unrelated numbers and item counts. Return JSON only with a results array of id, invoice and amount_cents. Return exactly one object per input note, preserving its id. /no_think
